result.explanation: Maintain one independent open panel per group. Apply the event, remove disabled selections, then refill empty required groups using fixed panel order. Emit global-order expansions and lexicographically sorted unsatisfied required IDs.
result.mapping: Group requirement and selected panel are controller state; panel enabled flags are mutable eligibility; output is a projection of those values.
result.assumptions: The supplied config remains available on every call. State is JSON-serializable and may contain only controller data.
